mapper.select: SELECT b.up_dict as type, a.task_id as task_code, a.task_name, a.task_level as priority, "3" as device_level, -- IFNULL(a.date_type, "") as time, "" as cycle_month, "" as cycle_week, "" as cycle_execute_time, "" as cycle_start_time, "" as cycle_end_time, "" as interval_number, "" as interval_type, "" as interval_execute_time, "" as interval_start_time, "" as interval_end_time, "" as invalid_start_time, "" as invalid_end_time, '0' isenable, u.user_name as creator, DATE_FORMAT(a.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as fixed_start_time, DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time from u_patrol_task a left join sys_user u on a.create_user_id = u.user_id left join t_dict_business b on a.task_type = b.dict_code and b.col_name="plan_type"
SELECT count(1) AS totalNum, sum(IF(result.cruise_status = 252, 0, 1)) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_data_result result WHERE result.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}
SELECT count(1) AS totalNum, count(result.identify_result) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_data_result result WHERE result.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}
